pricing_reviews.explanation: The 2026-27 nonresident MCS table separates base tuition, a tuition increment and non-tuition fees, and caps tuition at the 9+ credit row. A verified term-by-term 31-credit billing plan is missing; multiplying one flat credit price or a generic annual total is not a verified full-program quote.

The applicable 2026-27 professional engineering rate is USD 30,720 per semester, separate from fees and online-MCS pricing. A normal three-semester duration does not prove an invariant required billing schedule for every full-time student; full-program tuition remains unknown.

Registrar PDF page 1 lists a USD 63,500 program fee for the Fall 2026 cohort, paid over five quarters, with campus fees/insurance separately listed and later totals TBD. The Fall 2027 row is that cohort's continuation, not a quote for new Fall 2027 entrants. Do not use an annual subtotal or silently equate mixed program charges to tuition-only cost.

The CICS page combines USD 60,750 out-of-state/international tuition and mandatory fees, without a clearly applicable billing period. Its fee components and the separate Bursar enrollment tiers do not establish a reproducible tuition-only total for 30 required credits.

The program directs applicants to its exact Illinois calculator selection and changes new MCS entrants to self-supporting status in Fall 2027. The captured calculator offers start terms only through Summer 2027; no applicable Fall 2027 entrant rate was returned. Do not substitute Chicago, online or pre-change funding/rates.
